snippet.title: Get Ready for Hunting Season | BULT Hunting Simulator Teaser 2025
snippet.description:
BULT — Realistic Hunting Simulator
Step into the wild and experience waterfowl hunting like never before. Built by real hunters, BULT focuses on realism, atmosphere, and true hunting strategy.

Hunting season starts soon — add the game to your Steam wishlist and don’t miss the release: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929200/BULT_Hunting_simulator
